description: Create a new directory (folder) to organize notes. `name` is required; optional `parent` (a directory id to nest under), `formatInstructions` (a house-style prompt notes filed here are auto-formatted to), and `icon` (emoji). Returns the created directory with its id.

formatInstructions.description: House-style prompt for notes filed into this directory

parent.description: Parent directory id to nest under; omit or 'root' for top-level

name: create_directory
title: Create directory
